channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
item.description: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, folding Pierre's Trees and Diffs libraries—already used by Codex—and its Code Storage feature into Codex while keeping them open source. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
item.description: Dharma Field Extractor, a 2-billion-parameter model trained with LoRA on 43,384 samples, converts any document type into JSON fields specified by an open request or schema, which Dharma-AI says outperforms every frontier LLM tested at a fraction of the cost. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
item.description: GitHub Copilot is now in public preview inside Xcode 27.3 beta’s built-in coding assistant, requiring macOS Tahoe 26.6 or later and setup via Settings > Intelligence, with all Copilot plans supported and the original Xcode extension retained. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
item.description: OpenAI’s autonomous pipeline analyzed 2,308 Linux kernel candidates, dynamically reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation flaws at an API cost of $1,213,400. (OpenAI News)

item.title: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata
item.description: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves query accuracy for Java/Kotlin, Rust and C/C++, strengthens security checks when bundling or publishing a pack, and corrects query metadata. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Claude pulls the 40-year-old cell vault puzzle into structural biology's view
item.description: Using Claude, Anthropic’s biology team resolved the first three-dimensional structure of a prokaryotic Vault, identifying candidates across 29 bacterial and 4 archaeal phyla and cutting purification from 3 days to 90 minutes. (AIbase)

item.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
item.description: Daybreak Red now offers GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved government security teams in AWS GovCloud (US-East) via Amazon Bedrock for vulnerability research, reproduction and remediation assessment, with inference data excluded from model training. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Claude Code relaxes its game ban: a passing mention of "referencing a game" no longer triggers a refusal
item.description: Anthropic engineer Adi Othmani said on November 4 that Claude Code 2.1.317 loosened Claude Opus 5.5's game-development limits, so naming an existing game when describing gameplay is no longer rejected, after a hard anti-plagiarism rule was withdrawn for false positives. (AIbase)

item.title: Early clues to GPT-6.2 leak as three new OpenAI models may debut this week
item.description: Codex usage details quietly listed a gpt-6.2-astra tag while the interface still showed only GPT-6 Astra, and The Information reports OpenAI may launch Astra, Sol and a cybersecurity model Cyber as early as Nov 6. (AIbase)

item.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor to double down on agentic coding
item.description: Meta confirmed its acquisition of AI coding startup Conductor, whose platform deploys multiple agents into parallel workspaces to launch software projects, with Axios first reporting the deal and founder Charlie Holtz teasing new customer offerings for early next year. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI's new model automatically finds 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities, with each exploit costing just $1,279
item.description: OpenAI's November 4 security report says its upcoming cybersecurity model reproduced 1,724 of 2,308 candidate vulnerabilities and generated 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation exploits at an average API cost of $1,279. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst and Flare, cutting image generation latency to as low as 5 seconds
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst and Flare, image generation models that are more than twice as fast as GPT Image 2.5 with latency as low as 5 seconds, adding dynamic reasoning, with Sunburst ranked second on the Text-to-Image Arena. (AIbase)

item.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system
item.description: AT&T's Connected Life System is the first home security system to integrate with Gemini for Home, letting subscribers on the $29.99/month plan get AI event summaries and search recorded video history. (The Verge)

item.title: KREV AI — An AI team that runs your ecommerce brand
item.description: The KREV AI page bills itself as "an AI team that runs your ecommerce brand," yet its body holds only a CAPTCHA security check, with no product details, data or readable content. (Product Hunt)

item.title: OpenAI adds a built-in GIF generator to ChatGPT, powered by an unreleased Images2.6 model
item.description: OpenAI has built a GIF generator into ChatGPT, using its unpublished Images2.6 model to turn text or uploaded photos into looping animations with speed controls, frame-by-frame viewing and quick edits, as weekly image generation exceeds 4 billion. (AIbase)

item.title: 高通 Cloud AI 100 Ultra——150W 人工智能加速卡，配备 128GB 内存，传输速率达 548GB/s
item.description: 高通 Cloud AI 100 Ultra——150W 人工智能加速卡，配备 128GB 内存，传输速率达 548GB/s (www.qualcomm.com)

item.title: Orphex MCP — Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP
item.description: Orphex MCP's title claims one unified MCP can run an entire digital marketing stack, but the body is only a CAPTCHA security verification screen, leaving no substantive content to read. (Product Hunt)

item.title: YouTube视频广告被指充斥AI骗局产品
item.description: YouTube视频广告被指充斥AI骗局产品 (www.davidralphlewis.co.uk)

item.title: iOS 27.3 beta officially integrates Alibaba's Qwen, taking over ChatGPT's role
item.description: iOS 27.3 beta brings Alibaba's Qwen into Apple Intelligence in China, replacing ChatGPT, with a two-step activation and an approximately 7GB on-device model handling daily tasks locally while complex tasks call Qwen. (AIbase)
